# About Me

[comment]: <> (This is a comment, it will not be included)

![](assets/DSC08728cropped.jpg){.profile-pic} 

I use bioinformatics, data science, and machine learning to study human health and disease. I'm particularly interested in improving outcomes in autoimmune disease.

I am currently a Senior Scientist of Computational Biology at <a href="https://cabalettabio.com/" target="_blank">Cabaletta Bio</a>.

You can find links to my work on <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ovOqiWYAAAAJ&hl=en" target="_blank">Google Scholar</a> and <a href="https://github.com/dombraccia" target="_blank">Github</a>.
